👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, jab bhi duniya mein war hoti hai, humein sirf barbaadi hi barbaadi dikhai deti hai. Shehar tabah ho jaate hain, economies toot jaati hain, aur sabse badi baat—laakhon log apni jaan gawa dete hain. Isliye surface par dekha jaaye toh war duniya ki sabse illogical cheez lagti hai. Aakhir kaise koi aisi cheez justify kar sakta hai jisme dono deshon ka nuksaan hota hai, dono taraf ke log marte hain, aur poori societies tabah ho jaati hain?
Lekin phir ek bahut bada sawaal uthta hai: agar war itni hi buri cheez hai, toh phir duniya mein wars rukti kyun nahi? Reality yeh hai ki modern duniya mein war sirf politics ya ideology ka game nahi raha. Kai experts kehte hain ki aaj ke time mein war ek massive business ecosystem ban chuka hai—aisa business jahan kuch companies aur industries itna paisa kamaati hain ki aam insaan us scale ko imagine bhi nahi kar sakta.
Isi phenomenon ko samajhne ke liye humne pichhle kuch mahino mein kai research papers padhe, historical wars analyse kiye, aur un companies ko study kiya jo defence sector mein kaam karti hain. Aur aaj ke is episode mein hum breakdown karenge ki kaise United States ne ek powerful “war machine” build ki, kaise global conflicts defence companies ke liye massive business opportunities ban jaate hain, aur is poori kahaani se hum geopolitics aur power politics ke baare mein kya seekh sakte hain.

Research Paper Mentioned: https://costsofwar.watson.brown.edu/costs/economic/us-federal-budget
